rules.provenance: New pedagogical assumptions, NOT the unavailable original generator, NOT measurements or verified automotive thresholds.
rules.generation: Independent Monte Carlo vehicles/scenarios from reference profiles; no original targets copied, no duplicated or jittered original rows.
rules.Y2: new_margin < -5 AND alternator_health >= 85 AND battery_SOH >= 75 AND installation_fault == 0 AND ground_drop < 0.2 AND amplifier_play > 10 AND idle_share > 0.35
rules.rounding: Component/supply currents rounded to 2 decimals before computing totals, margins and labels; voltage rounded to 3 decimals.
rules.units: Currents A; voltage V; health/SOH/SOC/volume percent 0..100; RMS and idle share 0..1; RPM revolutions/minute.
rules.music: Genre/singer independently randomized; neither enters electrical formulas or labels.
rules.limitations: Mixing generator versions changes distributions; more simulated rows do not provide real-world validation. Retain batch lineage and evaluate versions separately when interpreting performance.

validation: Exact 43-column schema, unique scenarios, distinct vehicle groups, valid numerical ranges; pre-existing bytes preserved.
existing_models: Not retrained. Existing metrics/artifacts refer to the prior 2880-row dataset; run train in a fresh output directory.
